brief:
Defend Our Juries plans a rally Sunday at Labour's conference, framing the action as an "integrity test" for the UK's new premier, Al Jazeera English reported. The pro-Palestine group's demonstration will coincide with the party gathering.

The timing places pressure on Labour leadership over its position on Palestinian rights as the newly elected government settles into office. Details of the rally's specific demands and scale were not immediately available.
dek: Defend Our Juries say Sunday's action is an 'integrity test' for the UK's new premier.
title: Pro-Palestine group rallies at Labour conference, tests Starmer's stance
